detail: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength, detail scale

chronoseries.name: Emiliania

predecessor.status: reconstructed: six wavelengths on the same 46.464 nm patch that holds eight Holocene wavelengths. Not a measured fossil spacing and not a sibling-slot parameter.

successor.status: no successor chronospecies; the extant Holocene value is the terminal node, so the successor delta is zero

chronoseries.change_at_this_node: Relative to the reconstructed predecessor the critical repeat shortens by 1.936 nm and the patch gains two modes (6 to 8). Nothing changes against a successor.

equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)

calcite_yardstick.note: 11 calcite a-axis cells are 5489 pm and 12 are 5988 pm, so 5.808 nm is not an integer lattice multiple.

goodness_of_fit.note: Pearson r compares analytic growth rates with the spectral integrator on eight wavenumbers in the selection band. The value is not 1.

specimen.attribution: Griet Neukermans and Georges Fournier; coccolith SEM by Jeremy Young, University College London. Figure associated with doi:10.3389/fmars.2018.00146.
specimen.what_it_shows: Scanning electron micrograph of an Emiliania huxleyi coccosphere and a single coccolith at micrometre scale. It is the phenotypic specimen, not a 5.8 nm micrograph.
specimen.gallery_note: The species-gallery JPEG is the same micrograph recompressed (pixel correlation 0.99996). This slot vendors the Wikimedia original.

reported_in_source: Turing 1952: a reaction-diffusion system can select a finite critical wavelength.
Schnakenberg 1979: the two-species kinetics f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v.
Young and Henriksen 2003 and Henriksen et al. 2004: Emiliania coccoliths are calcite crystals grown in vesicles; coccolith-associated polysaccharide blocks acute step sites.
reconstructed_in_script: a=0.10, b=0.90 and D_v/D_u=18 are chosen so the analytic peak is exactly 5.808 nm.
The predecessor spacing 7.744 nm is defined by placing six wavelengths on the eight-wavelength Holocene patch.
The GIF maps that molecular field onto a coccosphere and coccolith silhouette whose spoke count is the tangential-Sobel harmonic of the real SEM (30).
transfer_boundary: The vendored SEM is a micrometre-scale phenotype. The model scale is 5.808 nm. The render is a phenotypic map of the molecular field, not a claim that the photograph resolved that wavelength.
does_not_claim: That Emiliania huxleyi has pigment stripes or ocelli at 5.8 nm.
That CAP adsorption kinetics are Schnakenberg kinetics.
That 7.744 nm has been measured on a fossil predecessor.
That a single SEM validates the wavelength law.
